amendment_forbidden: a written pre-execution manifest is never amended; post-execution provenance is a separate, append-only record

digest_convention.note: computed over the CANONICAL serialization, never over raw file bytes; hashing raw bytes yields a different value and would raise a false tamper alarm on an intact manifest
digest_convention.scope: the manifest payload with its own 'digest' key removed

resume_contract.post_execution_provenance: separate, append-only, never merged into this manifest
